findings.diagnosis: Three changes compound. The cleft made the shared insight the subject, which is what the paragraph is about. Enormous was the word making the differences worth overcoming. And the it is not, it is pair kept the relational field in the same grammatical position across both sentences, so the substitution is visible; the pass's version leads with the concession, which gives procedures the sentence-initial position in a paragraph arguing they are not primary. findings.summary: A four-clause when series lost three of its whens, collapsing four conditions into one.

evidence.baseline: coherent when its decisions remain in living feedback with the realities those decisions affect, when disagreement can be metabolized rather than suppressed, when intelligence remains distributed across appropriate scales ... and when the conditions of legitimacy are actively cultivated
evidence.shipped: coherent when its decisions remain in living feedback with the realities they affect, disagreement can be metabolized rather than suppressed, intelligence remains distributed across appropriate scales ... and the conditions of legitimacy are actively cultivated

findings.diagnosis: The repeated when makes four independent conditions, each of which a governance system could fail alone. Dropped, the four become one compound condition governed by a single when, which reads as a definition with four parts. The distinction matters because the section then spends three paragraphs on three of the four as separate mechanisms. The realities those decisions affect was also pronominalized to they, and the sentence contains two plural candidates.

findings.summary: Concessions and qualifications were removed from all three mechanism paragraphs.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.14 read onto not glamorous.
findings.diagnosis: Each removal costs the same thing: an acknowledgment that the reader might reasonably resist. Not glamorous concedes the obvious objection to institutional plumbing before making the largest claim in the paragraph, and the but is what earns the claim. The semicolon in are not separate from governance; they are foundational holds a refusal and its correction in one breath, which is the construction the section uses throughout. And But it has been honored more in name than in practice sets up a contrast with the sentence before; without the But the paragraph reads as two unconnected facts about subsidiarity.

findings.summary: Traditions became practices, removing the lineages the paragraph was crediting.

evidence.baseline: This is why traditions of restorative justice, contemplative deliberation, council-based decision-making, and somatic facilitation have been quietly producing better governance outcomes for centuries
evidence.shipped: This is why restorative justice, contemplative deliberation, council-based decision-making, and somatic facilitation have quietly produced better governance outcomes for centuries

findings.diagnosis: Traditions of is the word that makes the sentence about lineages rather than techniques, which matters in a paragraph whose complaint is that political science dismissed them as peripheral. A tradition is carried by people over centuries; a practice can be recovered by anyone. Have been quietly producing is also continuous and unfinished, where have quietly produced closes the record.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F3 is a pattern now visible across three chapters: the pass removed concessions at a much higher rate than claims. Not glamorous, not romantic relics, all the pressures any business faces, the honest answer is that. Each is the writer granting a point before making one, and each reads in isolation as material a compression pass can drop without losing information. The information it loses is that someone anticipated an objection, which is most of what separates an argument from an assertion.
